annotatedSteps.studentWork: Live wire — red insulation; neutral wire — black insulation.
P = VI ⇒ I = P/V = 1000 W / 220 V = 4.54 A. So the current rating of the circuit should be 4.54 A.
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ½ Current calculated correctly, but standard domestic circuit rating is 5 A
annotatedSteps.correctedWorking: I = P/V = 1000 W / 220 V = 4.54 A. Since the current drawn is 4.54 A, a standard circuit rating of 5 A should be used.

annotatedSteps.description: Function and advantage of the earth wire
annotatedSteps.studentWork: The earth wire provides a low-resistance conducting path to the earth, so any current leaking to the metal body of the iron flows to the earth and the body stays at earth potential. Thus the user does not get an electric shock.
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Comprehensive explanation covering both low-resistance path and protection from shock

results.teacherNote: Very good understanding of domestic circuits. Note that current ratings of domestic circuits follow standard commercial values (such as 5 A or 15 A), so a device drawing 4.54 A requires a 5 A rated circuit.

annotatedSteps.description: Image characteristics for m = -2 and u = -20 cm
annotatedSteps.studentWork: m = −2 (negative) ⇒ (I) the image is real and inverted; (II) it is twice the size of the object (magnified); (III) v = m × u = (−2) × (−20) = +40 cm, i.e. 40 cm on the other side of the lens, beyond 2F; (IV) the height of the image is negative.
